CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  May 24, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Absent:  Ankit Udani,
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

ITEM 1: MINUTES - May 10, 2022

MOTION:
  • Daninger moved to approve the consent agenda as submitted.
  • The second was by Tsai.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes: None
  Absent: Ankit Udani

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2: 1712 S. Olive Avenue
This application is for a one-story addition and a porch to an existing single-family residence.
Applicant: Nga Banh

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The material board shall be included in the revised drawings; 2. The drawings shall be updated to
show the front elevation accurately; 3. MWELO compliant documents shall be provided during plan
check; and 4. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff during plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
Staff comments were given. The applicant was present and stated that Sheet 4 is to serve as the
materials board. Tsai stated that the roof material should be consistent throughout. Clarification is
necessary for the space in the attic given the 3:12 slope in the rear. Hernandez concurred with Tsai.
  1
 Daninger questioned if the rear portion of the house is original to the house. The applicant stated
that this is the condition when the current owner purchased the house. The applicant also stated that
there may be changes in the rear patio based on an existing tree. The Board explained to the applicant
that the conditional changes and any

MOTION:
  • Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The roof material shall be consistent throughout the house.
  2. The material board shall be included in the revised drawings;
  3. The drawings shall be updated to show the front elevation accurately;
  4. MWELO compliant documents shall be provided during plan check; and
  5. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to plan
  check.
  • The second was by Tsai.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes: None
  Absent: Ankit Udani

ITEM 3: 1600 Cabrillo Avenue
This application is for a one-story addition and a porch to an existing single-family residence.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that any
MWELO compliant documents be provided during plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
Evan Chou, the applicant was present. Daninger stated that Sheet A2 shows round dormer attic
vents. The applicant stated that these were preferred due to less leaking. Tsai questioned the front
elevation and confirmed that the large feature window was existing. He stated further that his
concern was that this is a corner property and the building does not address the corner. Also, the
existing house has roof and building modulation whereas the proposed design is a single rectangle.
Hernandez recommended additional modulation and/or a larger porch to address this concern.

The owner stated that he wanted an office in the front. Tsai stated that the roof needed additional
modulation so that the roof was not massive in appearance. Abe stated that the issues that the owner
presented are not in question. Location of programmatic elements can be addressed regardless of
the design modulation.

MOTION:
  • Tsai moved to continue the application.
  • The second was by Hernandez.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes: None
  Absent: Ankit Udani

  2
 ITEM 4: 108 South 1st Street.
This application is for a uniform sign program for an existing commercial building.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The awning sign copy shall be documented as 5 inches maximum; 2. The width of the wall signage
shall not exceed 10 feet; and 3. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff
prior to permit issuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant questioned his next steps on his revision to the USP document. Daninger and Tsai
concurred with staff comments.

MOTION:
  • Daninger moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The awning sign copy shall be documented as 5 inches maximum;
  2. The width of the wall signage shall not exceed 10 feet; and
  3. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit
  issuance.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes: None
  Absent: Ankit Udani

ADJOURNMENT:
There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:20 P.M. to Tuesday, June 14, 2022.

MOTION:
  • Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:20
  • Seconded by Tsai
  • The motion carried 3-0 by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes: None
  Absent: Ankit Udani

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 14th day of June, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman
